cards.title: Your test-day plan
cards.body: The night before: sleep, pack pencils, an eraser, scrap paper, a watch and your ID, and don't cram. On the day: eat breakfast and arrive early. In the test: read each problem carefully, use your pacing plan and the 2-minute rule, leave a blank unless you can rule out two choices, and check your answer sheet in the last few minutes.

cards.title: The final mock
cards.body: Take this mock exactly as you'll take the real test: same time of day if you can, same plan, no interruptions. Then do the mistake analysis one last time and write down the one thing to remember on test day.

cards.title: Mistake analysis
cards.body: After the mock, open your result and sort every miss and blank into one of four boxes: (1) I didn't know the idea, (2) a careless slip, (3) I misread the question, (4) I ran out of time. Add the problems you didn't know to your error log, and look at the review by strand and by difficulty: is one strand weak, or do the points leak away in the last ten problems?

prompts: What is the one thing you'll remember on test day?
